compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: Capability probe runs and round-trips: create test issue, attach dso-id:<uuid> label, write dso_local_id entity property, confirm label JQL returns the issue, confirm REST property read returns the value, delete test issue — exit 0 with no errors

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/jira-capability-probe.py` using AcliClient (imported via importlib from acli-integration.py).

Given/When/Then test spec:
Given JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN are set and AcliClient is mocked so create_issue returns 'DIG-9999', search_issues returns [{'key':'DIG-9999'}], and get_issue_property returns the same uuid that set_issue_property received;
When jira-capability-probe.py is executed as a script;
Then stdout contains 'PROBE_PASS step=STEP_CREATE', 'PROBE_PASS step=STEP_LABEL', 'PROBE_PASS step=STEP_PROPERTY_WRITE', 'PROBE_PASS step=STEP_JQL_SEARCH', 'PROBE_PASS step=STEP_PROPERTY_READ', 'PROBE_PASS step=STEP_DELETE' in order; AcliClient.delete_issue called exactly once with 'DIG-9999'; process exits 0.

Structure:
- Load `acli-integration.py` via `importlib.util.spec_from_file_location` (matching test pattern)
- Read JIRA_URL/JIRA_USER/JIRA_API_TOKEN; exit 2 + PROBE_FAIL reason=missing_credentials if any missing
- Generate dso-id:<uuid4> label string
- Instantiate AcliClient, run six-step round-trip:
  1. STEP_CREATE: create_issue(project=DIG, summary='DSO capability probe <uuid>', issuetype=Task)
  2. STEP_LABEL: add dso-id:<uuid> label via update
  3. STEP_PROPERTY_WRITE: set_issue_property('dso_local_id', <uuid>)
  4. STEP_JQL_SEARCH: search_issues with 3x retry, 2s backoff (JQL indexing lag)
  5. STEP_PROPERTY_READ: get_issue_property('dso_local_id') — assert value == uuid
  6. STEP_DELETE: delete_issue in finally block (best-effort cleanup)
- Exit 0 on all PASS; exit 1 on step failure; exit 2 on missing credentials
- chmod +x the script

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && bash -c "$TEST_CMD"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && bash -c "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && bash -c "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] Probe exits 0 and emits all six PROBE_PASS labels in order when AcliClient round-trip succeeds
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_jira_capability_probe.py::test_probe_round_trip_passes_all_six_steps -xvs
- [ ] Probe exits 2 with PROBE_FAIL reason=missing_credentials when JIRA_URL is empty
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_jira_capability_probe.py::test_probe_exits_2_on_missing_credentials -xvs
- [ ] Probe exits 1 and still calls delete_issue when STEP_PROPERTY_READ returns wrong value
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_jira_capability_probe.py::test_probe_exits_1_on_property_read_mismatch_and_still_cleans_up -xvs
- [ ] Probe retries JQL search up to 3 times (2s sleep) before failing STEP_JQL_SEARCH
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/scripts/test_jira_capability_probe.py::test_probe_retries_jql_search_three_times -xvs
- [ ] jira-capability-probe.py is executable (mode bit set)
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/jira-capability-probe.py

## .test-index Entry
Source file `plugins/dso/scripts/jira-capability-probe.py` must be indexed:
  plugins/dso/scripts/jira-capability-probe.py:tests/scripts/test_jira_capability_probe.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
